name: Enrich Rikishi
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: "1 = preview only (writes nothing), 0 = write to Notion"
        default: "1"
        required: true
      names:
        description: "Comma-separated Ring Names (leave blank for retired 20 + Tomokaze)"
        default: ""
        required: false
jobs:
  enrich:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - name: Run enrichment
        run: node enrich-rikishi.mjs
        env:
          NOTION_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NOTION_TOKEN }}
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}
          NAMES: ${{ inputs.names }}
